name: Avatar
description:
The Avatar component is a versatile UI element that allows users to have a visual representation of their presence within an application. It is composed of several primitives that enable customization and flexibility in its usage.

The Avatar component can be used in various contexts, such as profiles, App Bars, menus, or any other content that benefits from a user representation. It supports different palettes, gradients, and layout styles to match the design requirements of your application.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An entry abstraction for rendering all the content-related primitives

props.name: alt
props.description: The alternative text for the image. Required when `src` is set.

props.name: src
props.description: The image source URL. When omitted, only the `fallback` is rendered.

props.name: fallback
props.description: The content shown when there is no image or it fails to load, such as initials or an icon.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Avatar component.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Functional called when the image loading status changes.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the avatar. Useful for composition.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
